worker_claiming.without_redis: synchronous in-process execution — no concurrent claiming

checkpoint_scoping.mechanism: saveRunToDb() uses ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE

github_mutation_scoping.pr_creation: listPullRequests(head branch) before createPullRequest — defense-in-depth idempotency

recovery_scoping.query: SELECT id FROM runs WHERE status = 'active' AND phase NOT IN ('DONE', 'FAILED_BLOCKED', 'FAILED') AND finished_at IS NULL ORDER BY started_at ASC
recovery_scoping.scoping: ALL active incomplete runs — NO per-run filter beyond status/phase
recovery_scoping.cross_run_risk: HIGH — if Run B is 'active' at recovery time, it WILL be recovered alongside Run A
recovery_scoping.mitigation: Run B should reach 'DONE' (finished_at set) BEFORE recovery scans. If Run B is still active, both get recovered — but each recovers independently since PR pre-existence check prevents duplicates.

global_mutable_state.risk: MEDIUM — within same process, adapters are shared. With BullMQ (Redis) job isolation mitigates this. Without Redis, runs are synchronous so no concurrency risk.

high_risk_findings: Recovery queries ALL active incomplete runs — parallel recovery risk if Run B is still active during Run A recovery
verdict: AMBER — recovery scoping needs Run B to reach DONE before Run A recovery scan; otherwise both get recovered (but no duplicates due to PR pre-existence check)
